__broaden__.ἡ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. nom. sg.: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a pool of water (ἡ δὲ προσέπλαζε ’and it lapped up’) · also fem. nom. sg. ’it’, of a ship (ἡ δ’ ἔθει ’and it ran’)
__broaden__.δυνάμεσθα: δύναμαι — be able, can; epic pres. opt. 1 pl. (= Attic δυναίμεθα): with κεν ’we could’ · also pres. indic. 1 pl., epic -μεσθα (= Attic δυνάμεθα): ’we were able’ (+ inf.)
__broaden__.ἔκταμεν: ἐκτέμνω — cut out, cut down; aor. 3 sg. (ν-movable), unaugmented (= ἐξέταμε) · also κτείνω — kill; aor. 1 pl., epic short form (= Attic ἐκτείναμεν): ’we killed’
__broaden__.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., of manner: ’as’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I shall say’) · also comparative ’like’, standing before its noun (ὡς νυκτερίς ’like a bat’)
__broaden__.πολλὸν: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, epic (= Attic πολύ): ’much’ · also attributive, neut. nom. sg. agreeing with μέθυ: ’much (wine)’ · also neut. acc. sg. as substantive object: ’much (wine)’ · also adj.: ’big’ · also epic πολλόν (= πολύν), masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόνον: ’long (time)’
__broaden__.ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν) · also temporal ’until’ + opt., of a hoped-for event (ὄφρ’ ἐξεμέσειεν ’until she should vomit out’)
__broaden__.πέσον: πίπτω — fall; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεσον): ’I fell’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (same form): ’they fell’
__broaden__.ἐφοίτων: φοιτάω — roam, go to and fro, come repeatedly; impf. 3 pl.: ’came thronging’ · also impf. 1 sg. (same form): ’I went to and fro’
__broaden__.τρόπιος: τρόπις — keel; fem. gen. sg., governed by περί: ’around, astride the keel’ · also gen. of separation with a verb of loosing: ’from the keel’
__broaden__.ἐμυθεόμην: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak; impf. 1 sg. mid., iterative sense: ’I used to tell’ · also ’I told, I was telling’, of a single past telling
__broaden__.ἰφθίμῃ: Ἰφθίμη — Iphthime, Penelope’s sister, wife of Eumelus; fem. dat. sg. · also ἴφθιμος — mighty, stout; adj., fem. dat. sg. form, qualifying θυγατέρ’ · also ἴφθιμος, fem. dat. sg., agreeing with ἀλόχῳ: ’mighty (wife)’
__broaden__.εἶχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 1 sg. (the form also serves 3 pl.): ’I had’ · also + inf., ’I was able’ (οὐδέ πῃ εἶχον στηρίξαι ’nor could I in any way brace myself’)
